operation_details.item: The user scheduled a company town hall for next Friday about the restructuring.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: How’s the restructuring work moving along today?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: The role-mapping review is complete, so we’ve cleared a useful milestone.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That should make the communication plan much easier to shape.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Exactly. We’re currently drafting it, and managers are preparing their team Q&A notes.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Good combination—clear role mapping, a coordinated message, and practical support for teams.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: I also scheduled a company town hall for next Friday about the restructuring.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That gives everyone a shared point in time. Are you planning to use it mainly for the announcement or for live questions as well?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Both—the core update first, followed by open Q&A.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Please forget only the scheduled restructuring town hall, while keeping the completed role-mapping, the comms plan, and the manager preparation.
